moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title, and who's starting strong on the opening weekend?

angles.name: Local Team Focus
angles.copy: Devon, get ready! The Premier League is back. Who are you most excited to see in action this weekend?

angles.name: Promoted Teams
angles.copy: Newly promoted Coventry City, Hull City, and Ipswich Town are ready to make their mark in the Premier League. Can they shock the big guns this season?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival 2026
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals are set to take over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from Thursday, August 27th to Sunday, August 30th, coinciding with the August Bank Holiday weekend.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival is just over a week away! Who are you most excited to see on the lineup this year? Let the Bank Holiday weekend commence!

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: If you're heading to Reading or Leeds for the Bank Holiday weekend, you're in for a treat! Four days of incredible music are on the way.

angles.name: Local Excitement
angles.copy: Leeds, get ready! The biggest weekend of the year is almost here as Reading & Leeds Festival takes over Bramham Park for the Bank Holiday.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No. 1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's collaboration 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 20, 2026.

angles.name: Current Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds strong at UK Number 1. Are you still streaming it non-stop?

angles.name: Weekend Playlist
angles.copy: Need a soundtrack for your Monday? The UK's Number 1, 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean, is still hitting all the right notes.

moments.title: Happy 32nd Birthday Phoebe Bridgers & UK Gigs
moments.blurb: US indie-rock singer-songwriter Phoebe Bridgers celebrates her 32nd birthday today and is playing live in the UK this week, including London tonight.

angles.name: Birthday & Live
angles.copy: Happy 32nd Birthday to the brilliant Phoebe Bridgers! Catch her live in London tonight or Brighton/Bristol later this week. What's your favourite Phoebe track?

angles.name: London Gig Tonight
angles.copy: London, tonight's your chance! Phoebe Bridgers is playing Union Chapel. Happy Birthday to her, and enjoy the show if you're going!

moments.title: Happy 57th Birthday Donnie Wahlberg
moments.blurb: Donnie Wahlberg, actor and member of iconic boyband New Kids on the Block, turns 57 today.

angles.name: Boyband Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to New Kids on the Block legend, Donnie Wahlberg! What's your favourite NKOTB song?

angles.name: Donnie Then & Now
angles.copy: From 'Hangin' Tough' to 'Blue Bloods', Donnie Wahlberg turns 57 today! A true multi-talent.

moments.title: Happy 57th Birthday Kelvin Mercer (De La Soul)
moments.blurb: Kelvin Mercer, better known as Posdnuos from the legendary hip-hop group De La Soul, celebrates his 57th birthday today.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to Kelvin Mercer, aka Posdnuos of the pioneering De La Soul! His influence on hip-hop is immeasurable.

angles.name: Taste The Ambiance
angles.copy: A true legend turns 57 today! Raise a glass to Posdnuos of De La Soul. What's your go-to track from '3 Feet High and Rising'?

moments.title: Happy 68th Birthday Belinda Carlisle
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead vocalist of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, turns 68 today.

angles.name: Pop-Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Heaven is a place on Earth for Belinda Carlisle, who celebrates her 68th birthday today! What's your favourite Go-Go's or solo hit?

angles.name: 80s Superstar
angles.copy: Still got the beat! Happy 68th Birthday to the incredible Belinda Carlisle. A true 80s icon.

moments.title: The Weeknd's After Hours Til Dawn Tour Continues at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour continues its run at London's Wembley Stadium tonight, with further dates on August 18th and 19th.

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: The Weeknd is still lighting up Wembley Stadium tonight! If you're heading to the 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour, get ready for an epic show.

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: London, The Weeknd is back at Wembley tonight! Who's ready for another night of hits?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's Eternal Sunshine Tour in London
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande continues her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' at The O2 in London tonight, with more dates on August 19th and 20th.

angles.name: Ariana Live
angles.copy: London is buzzing! Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' hits The O2 again tonight. Who's got tickets to see the pop superstar?

angles.name: Pop Queen in Town
angles.copy: Our pop queen Ariana Grande is performing at The O2 tonight! Expect a night of incredible vocals and hits.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just two weeks away, falling on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Two weeks until the August Bank Holiday! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer? Make it count!

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday on the 31st is fast approaching. It's the perfect chance for a final summer adventure!

moments.title: New Album Releases This Friday
moments.blurb: This Friday, August 21st, sees new album releases from artists including DMA'S, Sam Smith, Weezer, and a special archive release from Prince.

angles.name: New Music Friday Alert
angles.copy: Get ready for New Music Friday! Fresh albums dropping this week from DMA'S, Sam Smith, Weezer, and an exciting Prince archive release. What's on your listening list?

angles.name: Anticipated Releases
angles.copy: Big releases arriving this Friday! DMA'S with their self-titled album, Sam Smith's 'Hazel Eyes', Weezer's 'The Gold Album', and Prince's 'Timeless'. So much to dive into!
